item.title: Instacart Launches New Ad Program to Support Black-Owned CPG Brands – Black Business Guide
item.description: Through this new initiative, Instacart is offering Black-owned CPG brands the opportunity to reach a broader audience in the digital aisles.

item.title: As US Consumer Spending Returns to Normal, Interest in Investing Emerges as a Lasting Pandemic Legacy – Black Business Guide
item.description: Accumulated savings and stimulus checks helped fuel a surge of interest in active investments, which may be a lasting legacy of the pandemic.

item.title: This App is Helping Black Entrepreneurs Get Access to Mentorship From Industry Leaders – Black Business Guide
item.description: The Suites is a new platform and business community that helps connect Black entrepreneurs to mentorship and fundraising opportunities.

item.title: Russell Wilson Hosts Sneak Peek of His New Kids Clothing Line 3BRAND – Black Business Guide
item.description: Russell Wilson gave a sneak peek of his new children's clothing line, 3BRAND, at the opening of the new Rookie USA flagship store.

item.title: Black Tech Street and SecondMuse Launch NFT Fundraiser to Build Black Tech Hub in Tulsa – Black Business Guide
item.description: Black Tech Street and SecondMuse are auctioning a commemorative NFT as a fundraiser to build a Black technology hub in Tulsa.

item.title: H&M to Host "Buy From a Black Woman" Summer Pop-Up Shops at Select U.S. Store Locations – Black Business Guide
item.description: Retailer H&M has announced that it will host a series of pop-up shops highlighting Black women-owned businesses throughout the month of July.

item.title: Coca-Cola Steps up Spending With Minority-Owned Media Companies – Black Business Guide
item.description: Coca-Cola has announced plans to nearly double its spending with minority-owned media companies over the next three years.

item.title: Hue Society Announces Its 3rd Annual Wine & Culture Fest Celebrating Black and Brown Winemakers – Black Business Guide
item.description: Hue Society's Wine & Culture Fest will provide educational and developmental opportunities for attendees while honoring industry legends.

item.title: Subscription Social Media Startup Fanbase Unveils Creator Advisory Board – Black Business Guide
item.description: The newly formed board will direct the development and key functionality of Fanbase's new short form video editor feature on-platform.

item.title: Why Entrepreneurs Should Learn How to Sketch – Black Business Guide
item.description: Many people go through life noticing little of what's going on around them. When you learn to draw, you begin to see the world in new ways.
